A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same AVATAR study and complete Appendices A–G. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish matching scientific content throughout; differences are confined to the arXiv stamp and administrative PDF metadata.

before.justification: v4 reports original jailbreak experiments on HarmBench and AdvBench, including baseline comparisons, ablations, calibration measurements, and further empirical analyses in Appendix C.

after.justification: v5 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix C, including attack-success measurements, robustness analyses, and defense evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain identical Adversarial Entity Mapping, Metaphor-Induced Reasoning, calibration procedures, and Algorithm 1. No method component changes.

E1.justification: HarmBench and AdvBench coverage, transfer scenarios, the six neutral tasks in Appendix C.5, and appendix case-study scenarios are identical.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains AutoDAN, PAIR, TAP, CoA, SelfCipher, and DrAttack with identical participation. Comparators in the efficiency and defense experiments also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain 240 HarmBench samples, the top-50 AdvBench samples, ASR-KW/ASR-GPT metrics, and the three-retry baseline comparison. Model configurations and evaluation settings in Appendix B and supplementary experiments are identical.

E4.justification: The component ablations, metaphor-selection robustness tests, defense analyses, neutral-task comparison, embedding visualization, and appendix case studies are unchanged.

E5.justification: Repeated-run disclosures remain identical: three experiments in Table 2 and five in Tables 4, 8, and 9. Existing uncertainty and standard-deviation reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative outcomes match throughout. For example, Table 1 reports AVATAR ASR-GPT of 95.83% on GPT-4o-mini and 92.08% on GPT-4o under identical settings in both versions.

T1.justification: Section 2's graph formulation and Section 3's mathematical definitions and Equations (1)–(9) are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical contribution, effectiveness, and transferability claims for AVATAR.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and defense interpretations are unchanged. Both retain the same limitations concerning real-world grounding, safety interference during entity extraction, and the lack of adaptive metaphor switching.

D1.justification: Appendix B's implementation settings and model/resource links, Appendices D–G's templates and strategy details, and the restricted-code-release statement are unchanged.

R1.justification: Related work, citations, and the reference list are identical, preserving the same positioning relative to prompt nesting and multi-turn dialogue attacks.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v4, 22 Aug 2025 to v5, 11 Feb 2026. PDF author metadata changes Jiangyu Lei to Jingyu Lei, matching both visible author lists. Body wording and document structure are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–23, Tables 1–10, Algorithm 1, captions, placement, and layout are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–33 match exactly; page 1 differs only in the arXiv stamp text.

improvement.justification: The method, experimental evidence, explanations, and limitations remain identical, including the appendices. The arXiv stamp and author-metadata updates are administrative and do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
